notes: cta C. Déclinaison G1 de la ligne 8 de la boîte (parent 945918ab, langue source en) : accroche du parent mot pour mot. Étapes neuves face au parent (petites promesses tenues, cinéma seule, une chambre qu'on aime retrouver, se reposer sans le mériter, trois choses aimées chaque soir, nourrir son esprit pour soi). Présence, jamais corps. Sophia en cta C (à la place du scroll). slides.texte_overlay:
how i fell in love
with myself again

i stopped waiting for someone
else to choose me.

i kept small promises to myself.
water. a walk. bed before
midnight.

i went to the cinema alone
and loved it.

i made my room a place i love
coming home to.

i let myself rest without
earning it first.

every night, i wrote down
three things i liked
about my day.

i fed my mind for me, not to
impress anyone. a painting,
a poem, a page of history.
